case_name: Mallappa S/O.Channabasappa Katavi vs Savita W/O.Mallappa Katavi
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 13(1)(a) and (c) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 against the respondent for passing a decree of divorce. The petition was dismissed by the Family Court. This appeal has been preferred.

legal_principles.principle: A party's willingness to settle a dispute can be taken into account in disposing of an appeal.
legal_principles.held: View the submission made by the learned counsel for the respondent, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner reserves liberty to file a petition under Section 13(B) of the Family Court.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to file a petition under Section 13(B) of the Family Courts Act, if necessary.
